mutants.name: a D$ completion outside the window
an atomic answered by the D$
a Program Buffer load answered by the D$
a misaligned load answered by the D$
a refill counted as an access the head started
a drain does not wait for the refill
mutants.old: S_DRAIN: if (resp) begin state_q <= S_IDLE; fill_q <= 1'b0; end
mutants.new: S_DRAIN: begin state_q <= S_IDLE; fill_q <= 1'b0; end
mutants.note: the LSU only gives up an op it no longer wants; the next op waits for the D$ anyway (done_dc, dc_miss and start all need !i_dc_busy), and the buffer, the walker and the debug view wait on dc_busy in core.sv, so nothing can use the port or see the refill's answer

mutants.name: a bus ack taken while filling
a refill's answer taken from the bus
mutants.old: wire [63:0] rsp_dat = fill_q ? i_dc_fill_dat : done_dc ? i_dc_dat : wb_mem_dat_i;
mutants.new: wire [63:0] rsp_dat = fill_q ? wb_mem_dat_i : done_dc ? i_dc_dat : wb_mem_dat_i;

mutants.name: the LSU's own write keeps its line
mutants.old: assign o_dc_inv   = DC_EN && done_bus && !fill_q && kind_wr && pa_in_window && !wb_mem_err_i;

mutants.name: a miss asks during a drain beat
a hit's RVFI word is zero
a miss never refills
mutants.old: else if (dc_miss)    begin state_q <= S_BUS; early_q <= early; fill_q <= 1'b1; end
mutants.new: else if (1'b0)    begin state_q <= S_BUS; early_q <= early; fill_q <= 1'b1; end
